check_dependencies() {
    print_status "Checking dependencies..."
    
    # Check for Python 3
    if ! command -v python3 &> /dev/null; then
        print_error "Python 3 is required but not installed."
        exit 1
    fi
    
    # Check for pip - try multiple methods
    PIP_AVAILABLE=false
    
    if command -v pip3 &> /dev/null; then
        PIP_AVAILABLE=true
        PIP_CMD="pip3"
    elif command -v pip &> /dev/null; then
        PIP_AVAILABLE=true
        PIP_CMD="pip"
    elif python3 -m pip --version &> /dev/null; then
        PIP_AVAILABLE=true
        PIP_CMD="python3 -m pip"
    fi
    
    if [ "$PIP_AVAILABLE" = false ]; then
        print_warning "pip not found. Attempting to install pip..."
        install_pip
    else
        print_success "Found pip: $PIP_CMD"
    fi
    
    print_success "Dependencies check passed."
}

install_pip() {
    print_status "Installing pip..."
    
    # Try to install pip using the system package manager
    if command -v pacman &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python-pip using pacman..."
        sudo pacman -S --noconfirm python-pip
    elif command -v apt &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using apt..."
        sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y python3-pip
    elif command -v dnf &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using dnf..."
        sudo dnf install -y python3-pip
    elif command -v yum &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using yum..."
        sudo yum install -y python3-pip
    elif command -v zypper &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using zypper..."
        sudo zypper install -y python3-pip
    else
        # Fallback: install pip using ensurepip
        print_status "Installing pip using ensurepip..."
        python3 -m ensurepip --user --upgrade
    fi
    
    # Verify pip installation
    if python3 -m pip --version &> /dev/null; then
        PIP_CMD="python3 -m pip"
        print_success "pip installed successfully!"
    else
        print_error "Failed to install pip. Please install it manually."
        exit 1
    fi
}
